summary: The two direct capacity bounds follow correctly from the supplied mixed-integer centerpoint theorem and the arbitrary-selected-mass nonempty-core theorem. The trimmed matching defines a single submeasure of the mixed-volume measure with total mass 2P, so its centerpoint gives D at least 2P/3. Combining these estimates with the accepted matching inequalities yields the stated 4/39 bound, and the hard-descendant arithmetic gives exactly 148/1053. All zero-mass, nonattainment, boundary, and positivity cases used in the proof are handled.
